fusions.name: Broadside Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and knocking the target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spyglass Shot
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 40 damage, up to 2.4 times that at maximum range, and deals 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Wind in the Rigging
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Following Sea
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
